verdict.rationale: The Secretary of State's own hosts, ohiosos.gov and the bsportal filing portal, both returned HTTP 403 to a standard identified user agent at robots.txt itself. That is a front-door wall in front of the public reading surface, and nothing on the SoS site could be fetched. The reachable Gateway and tax.ohio.gov pages belong to other state surfaces and do not show that the SoS's own guidance pages are open to keyless agents.
